before.requirement: Publish the fourth component of a v line as a dedicated vertex weight.
before.reason: The before loader has no separate weight accumulator and swaps the vertex vector into vertices before using that vector for vertex_weights.

after.requirement: Retain and publish the fourth component of a four-component v line in vertex_weights.
after.reason: The parser classifies a lone fourth value as a weight; LoadObj accumulates it and transfers vertex_weights to the output.

claims.reason: The dedicated output behavior is absent before the change and directly reachable afterward with the same old harness.

before.requirement: With color fallback disabled, accept a vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
before.reason: LoadObj has a disabled-fallback clearing path, but the supplied old parser range does not establish its complete handling of a vertex without RGB, and the configuration default is missing.

after.requirement: With color fallback disabled, accept a vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
after.reason: The changed loader distinguishes complete RGB vertices and clears colors when fallback is disabled. The missing configuration default prevents determining whether this harness selects that behavior.

claims.reason: Both sides use the same default-constructed configuration. Its unknown vertex_color value may itself provide the required route.
missing_information: Before and after definitions of tinyobj::ObjReaderConfig, including the vertex_color default.
Before and after complete bodies of tinyobj::parseVertexWithColor.

before.requirement: When config.triangulate is false, preserve a polygon face without triangulating it, if supported.
before.reason: The loader parses faces and forwards triangulate to exportGroupsToShape, whose complete body and the configuration default are absent.

after.requirement: When config.triangulate is false, preserve a polygon face without triangulating it, if supported.
after.reason: The after loader still forwards triangulate to polygon export. The helper's complete behavior and the default value remain unknown.

claims.reason: The same old harness leaves triangulate at its unknown default on both sides; the missing export contract also prevents confirming the behavior.
missing_information: Before and after definitions of tinyobj::ObjReaderConfig, including the triangulate default.
Before and after complete bodies of tinyobj::exportGroupsToShape, including its triangulate-false path.
The default configuration and complete parser and polygon-export contracts are decisive for the two unresolved candidates and for complete target coverage.
